ModMetaData.name: Implant Salvage
ModMetaData.author: Luke
ModMetaData.description:
A raider dies wearing an archotech arm and a bionic heart, and you get nothing. In vanilla those parts only survive if you take him alive.
Implant Salvage lets a doctor cut them out of the body instead.
There is still a risk of botching the extraction. A useless doctor wrecks the implant about half the time. A good one almost never does.
Bodies worth salvaging get a marker so you can read a battlefield at a glance, and your stockpiles, crematoria and butcher tables can be told which corpses are worth keeping - bionics and better hauled in, peg legs left where they fell.
Implants only. Nobody is harvesting organs, so there is no mood or ideology fallout.
Requires Harmony. Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Tested in Multiplayer on 1.6 with no issues (Multiplayer isn't out for 1.7 yet).
WHAT'S NEW IN 1.0.1 - RimWorld 1.7 support. 1.6 keeps working. - Fixed: taking out an implant that sits inside a body part - a death acidifier, brain chips - destroyed that part and every other implant in it. Each implant now comes out on its own, the way vanilla removes implants, so a brain full of chips gives you every chip. - Extraction speed now follows the doctor's medical operation speed, so work-speed bonuses, medical skill and good hands all make it quicker. - Old extraction marks and the implant settings of deleted stockpiles are cleared out of your save automatically.
